description: This file implements event handling for ubus, generating and sending bbfdm events based on specific WiFi and periodic statistics events, including registration and management of ubus event handlers.

methods.name: get_events_dm_path
methods.description: Retrieves the device management path for a given event name from the event map list.

methods.name: get_events_args
methods.description: Retrieves the argument list for a given event name from the event map list.

methods.name: serialize_blob_msg
methods.description: Serializes blob attributes into a list of parameter-value nodes.

methods.name: get_dm_arg_value
methods.description: Finds the value of a specific event argument from the parameter-value list.

methods.name: generate_blob_input
methods.description: Generates input blob message from parameter-value list based on event type.

methods.name: generate_periodic_stat_input
methods.description: Generates input blob message for periodic statistics events from JSON report data.

methods.name: bbfdm_event_handler
methods.description: Handles ubus events, processes message data, and sends corresponding bbfdm events.

methods.name: add_ubus_event_handler
methods.description: Adds a ubus event handler to the list of handlers.

methods.name: free_ubus_event_handler
methods.description: Unregisters and frees all ubus event handlers in the list.

methods.name: register_events_to_ubus
methods.description: Registers predefined events to ubus and adds their handlers to the list.
